items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: On this was Billie Holiday, John Simmons, Jo Jones, Sweets Edison, Lester Young, Marlowe Morris was the piano player, and I played bass, too.

ctx.x: Well, in the early 1940's, maybe 1942 or 1944, I don't remember which, we did Jammin' the Blues. Gjon Mili produced this. This was another thing that Norman, I guess, was co-producer on. On this was Billie Holiday, John Simmons, Jo Jones, Sweets Edison, Lester Young, Marlowe Morris was the piano player, and I played bass, too. And that won some sort of an award. It's still around.
It's a classic film. I've seen it. I'd forgotten who was on piano.
